headline: 3 U.S. LNG Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching As Europe Hunts Gas
summary: Energy markets are being pulled in two directions at once, with Europe short on gas and buyers scrambling for reliable supply just as recession worries stalk households and factories. That mix of stress and urgency can create sharp winners and quiet losers, which is why U.S. LNG exporters and gas midstream infrastructure stocks are drawing fresh attention. This article breaks down three stocks from that group that appear particularly exposed to the latest news and explains what that exposure...
